items.en: Site of a former research base operated by the Tri-Tachyon Corporation; a massive containment failure released a highly energetic and seemingly self-sustaining process, or object, which melted into the crust leaving a plume of strange radiation which spews exotic particles to this day. The moon is abandoned of all human activity but for a network of orbiting hazard beacons maintained by the Knights of Ludd.

A large though otherwise anonymous metallic/silicate planetoid caught in the L4 point of the gas giant Salus, Nortia was once dedicated to seasonal robotic mining operations and substance abuse before being inundated with refugees during the Askonia Crisis. Once the strongest independent base of Charterist rebels in the system, a cabal of senior Tri-Tachyon executives has performed a hostile takeover - in every sense - with political cover from the post-Second Askonia Crisis interfactional resolution.

An armored spur used to protect the flank of a station's primary batteries, this defense element is constructed of modular nanoforged components mounted on a tough yet relatively flexible structural lattice. Station armor is designed to find an ideal compromise between hardness, deflection, impact absorption, and heat dispersion across a wide range of combat scenarios, and as a rule permits for more generous mass allowance than could be reasonably mounted on a starship.

Tracked rigs roamed the more stable provinces, tearing new roads amongst the machine-ruins littering the scars of strip mines to rip out rare or merely convenient ores for export.

Dark rumors circulate about the conditions of the mobile labor camps operated by Diktat Intelligence.

A lonely, distant asteroid might be hollowed out to provide a secure volume. Such hideaways are used by miners, surveyors, and by more powerful forces up to, and including, eccentric aristocrats, pirate-kings, and shadowy arms of the major factions 

Military outposts are not always polite enough to signal an officiously threatening warning before opening fire. Pirates tend not to follow such niceties as a rule.

Space marines maneuvered in successive waves of chaotic-seeming formations, swarms of drones and chaff designed to confound automated target-tracking. Heavy assault suits clung to support drones to decelerate on their thrusters until the last moment before contact to take and hold firing positions...

A spokesperson appeared in front of the chamber, a bay fitted with modular lighting and sound-dampening panels.

Voices murmured, indistinct. Shadowy delegates in the uniform of many factions, civilian and military, swarmed and met in brief standoffs only to retreat and reform by the logic of unheard negotiations. The call to order went unheeded.

Lights snapped on as motion detectors triggered.

A soft hum reverberated. Air circulation.

The lobby was tastefully luxurious and compact. No expense was spared, but concerns of mass and volumes were appreciated. This was a place to visit, not to live.
Perseus "Saturnian" Andrada was killed in some kind of botched operation involving "Doctor" Wyatt Cydonia in the cryosanctum facilities operated by Mbaye-Gogol.

Hercules "Cyrino" Andrada was an assistant academician at the Galatia Academy.

An assassination attempt was made - and failed due to your intervention. Hercules has been forced into hiding but may yet play some role.

You found evidence that Jason "Korin" Andrada came to Qaras and was killed in a shooting. It appears that he was not the target, however, simply a bystander.

K-O Jove sold hard evidence of Jason's death to someone who appears to be a Sindrian Diktat agent. It's unclear which ministry within the Sindrian Diktat this agent was working for.

You discovered Leonidas "Esculus" Andrada in a base inside the asteroid Irkalla. His body was kept alive while his mind was put into a simulation from birth. The AIs assigned to oversee his simulated development expressed a desire to escape.

The operation appears to be a failure; Leonidas was not capable of existing independently in the outside world.

Volturn was once a planet of agriculture and leisure to service the now annihilated city-moon, Opis. Refugees from the First Askonia Crisis swelled the population many-fold, filling the arcologies, resort-cruisers, and terraforming barges with makeshift housing. Light industry and aquaculture prevail, with products derived from the processing of sea-life modified to flourish in the world-ocean.

Achilles Andrada has transferred his government here after the destruction of Sindria, and is a demoralized garrison-state as hollow in purpose as its name. Perhaps lackadaisical enforcement is all that enables an uneasy reign over this world of stinking algae farms and floating slums which serve as hotbeds of resistance movements, esoteric cults, and criminal syndicates.

Volturn was envisioned as a planet of agriculture and leisure to service the now annihilated capital city-moon, Opis. Refugees from the Askonia Crisis swelled the population of Volturn many-fold, surpassing even the numbers of Sindria and filling the floating arcologies, resort-cruisers, and terraforming barges with makeshift housing. Light industry and aquaculture prevail with products derived from processing sea-life modified to flourish in the world-ocean.

The local uprising has made an uneasy transition to civilian government, albeit with the bulwark of a significant paramilitary garrison to rule a world of stinking algae farms and floating slums - hotbeds of resistance movements, esoteric cults, and criminal syndicates.

Hercules "Cyrino" Andrada was an assistant academician at the Galatia Academy.

Now he is dead at the hand of professional assassins. You might have saved his life but chose not to warn him at the moment of the attack.
